note: IPC-2152 is a set of measured charts, not a closed form. Nothing here is filled: the standard is paywalled, and every public copy found is a plot image or a screenshot of a plot - reading numbers out of a picture and calling them a standard table is exactly the kind of guessed engineering number this server refuses to produce. The validator that would accept a real transcription is calc/safety_table.py:validate_ipc2152.

why_empty.rule: a digitised guess is not a table
why_empty.what_was_looked_for: IPC-2152 charts (current vs cross-section, per copper weight and allowed temperature rise)
why_empty.what_was_found: plot images and screenshots only; no numeric transcription with a stated table/figure id and edition
what_blocks_filling: a chart read off an image has no stated uncertainty, and IPC-2152 vs IPC-2221 can differ by more than 3x - the error would be invisible
